title: Rate Limiter Service
subtitle: Production-Style Backend System
description: A microservice-ready rate limiter implemented in C++, designed for real backend usage with clean abstractions and fast request handling.
overview: Implemented a configurable rate limiting service that can sit in front of APIs or services to control traffic based on user tiers and policies.
features: Manager-based facade for plug-and-play integration
Config-driven rate limiting with startup-time loading
Lazy creation and reuse of limiter instances
Fast in-memory request path (no parsing or IO at runtime)
Support for multiple strategies: Fixed Window, Sliding Window, Token Bucket, Leaky Bucket
Clear separation of config, policy, factory, service, and algorithm layers

title: Scalable URL Shortener
subtitle: Distributed System Design
description: A production-style distributed URL shortener designed for high read traffic, horizontal scalability, and low-latency redirects.
overview: Designed a horizontally scalable URL shortener similar to Bitly using read/write service separation, distributed ID generation, and cache-first redirect handling.
features: Separated Read and Write services to handle heavy redirect traffic
Snowflake-based distributed ID generation for unique short URLs
ZooKeeper workerId assignment for distributed safety
Cache-aside pattern with Redis to reduce database load
Database primary-replica architecture for scalable reads
Support for custom alias URLs with subscription validation
Low latency redirect path optimized for cache hits

patterns.name: Cache Aside Pattern
patterns.usage: Efficient caching strategy for redirect lookups

patterns.name: Distributed ID Generation
patterns.usage: Snowflake algorithm for scalable unique ID generation

title: Task Management System
subtitle: Backend Architecture Inspired by Jira
description: A scalable backend system for task lifecycle management with event-driven notifications, state-based workflows, and clean layered architecture.
overview: Designed a modular task management backend inspired by Jira and GitHub Issues supporting task lifecycle management, comments, assignments, and event-driven notifications.
features: Layered architecture with Controller, Service, and Repository separation
State Pattern implementation for task lifecycle management
Event-driven system for domain event publishing
Observer-based notification architecture
Activity history logging for all task changes
Multi-user task assignment support
Comment system with permission validation

title: 🏧 ATM System
subtitle: Low-Level Design Implementation
description: A production-style low-level design of an ATM system focused on safe transaction execution and clean abstraction.
overview: Models core ATM behavior: authentication, transaction routing, balance updates, cash planning, receipt generation, and rollback control.
features: Transaction routing via Strategy
Handler pipelines using Chain of Responsibility
Safe commit and rollback handling
Context-driven execution
Denomination-based cash planning
Hardware abstraction layer
Receipt generation workflow

title: Parking Management System
subtitle: Low-Level Design Implementation
description: A clean object-oriented implementation of a parking lot system.
overview: Models real-world parking behavior: entry, slot allocation, ticketing, exit, pricing, payment, and slot release with well-defined boundaries.
features: Vehicle size–based slot allocation
Multi-floor structure
Dynamic fee calculation (rain fee, surge fee)
Payment lifecycle with retries
